To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the school psychologists' knowledge about the role of school psychologists in health matters is limited, and (b) the school psychologists are willing to participate in school-based health promotion activities.

(1) the majority of the professionals of psychology who participated in our study reported that they have knowledge and skills to work on health-related issues, (2) the majority of participants reported that they are interested in collaborating with other professionals on health-related issues in schools, (3) the majority of professionals of psychology reported that they are willing to work on mental health issues in schools.
the professionals of school psychology in Mexico perceive themselves as having knowledge and competences to work with health issues in the schools.

the role of school psychology in the promotion of health in schools and with the need to develop an integrative perspective of health in school psychology.

the integration of psychology with health in the schools has been a challenge for the profession.
the results of this research suggest that the role of psychologists in school settings should be expanded to include mental health and physical health promotion, prevention, and treatment services.
the school psychology profession is well positioned to contribute to the promotion of health, well being and positive development in children, adolescents, their families, and the schools.

the school psychologists in this sample are aware of the need to work with the health professionals in their schools, and they are willing to do so, as long as they are given the proper training.
there is a need to train psychologists to work in schools and to integrate their services with the school health team to promote the health and wellbeing of students.
